steps.title: Three sentence types
steps.intro: Tap a row to hear the example.
steps.note:
**Statements and W-questions: the verb is in position 2.** If something else comes first (*heute*), the subject moves **after** the verb.

**Yes/no questions: the verb is in position 1.**

questions.explain: Yes/no question → verb first. (*Du liest gern?* with rising voice is possible in speech, but the standard form is *Liest du gern?*)

questions.prompt: In the evening we watch a film.
options: Am Abend sehen wir einen Film.
Am Abend wir sehen einen Film.
Wir am Abend sehen einen Film.
